title: Inside Tungsten West's £71 Million Restart Financing
subtitle: Government Capital, Project Expenditure and Refinancing Risk at Hemerdon

fonts.title: Georgia Bold
fonts.fallbackReason: Source Sans 3 not installed; Arial permitted by SMPT v2

slides.sourceLine: Accepted FI001 research. Revision candidate for human editorial review.
slides.mechanism: Instrument-level financing analysis connects capital provision with expenditure, cash conversion and financing obligations.

slides.title: Government capital strengthens the restart and sets a financing timetable
slides.scope: National Wealth Fund (NWF) financing   /   Dated disclosures and independent analysis
slides.sourceLine: Accounts, approved 2 Sep 2026, pp37–38. October presentation, slides20,33. August terms, 25 Aug.
slides.mechanism: Capital access improves restart prospects while short debt tenor makes cash timing and refinancing material.
slides.caveat: Current headroom and repayment sufficiency remain unestablished.

slides.title: Financing and operating progress advanced through distinct 2026 milestones
slides.scope: Hemerdon, Devon   /   Drakelands Restoration Limited (DRL), wholly owned operating subsidiary
slides.sourceLine: Issuer releases: 25/28 Aug, 15/23 Sep. Accounts: published 3 Sep, approved 2 Sep. October deck: 13 Oct.
slides.mechanism: Drawdown strengthens the financing evidence beyond the announcement; operating disclosures establish a separate execution record.
slides.caveat: Chronology does not establish causal production impact.

slides.title: The £71m headline contains £61m of gross core financing
slides.scope: Instrument amounts   /   GBP million   /   Transaction financing, not current cash
slides.sourceLine: NWF and issuer releases, 25 Aug. Accounts pp37,65: full core draw by 2 Sep. Model Funding!D8:D12.
slides.mechanism: Separate instrument and availability treatments prevent conditional lending capacity being mistaken for cash.
slides.caveat: £61m is gross transaction financing; exact net equity proceeds and later uses are unreconciled.

slides.title: Equity absorbs residual risk and the loan requires repayment
slides.scope: NWF equity in Tungsten West plc   /   Proposed loan borrower: DRL, with group guarantees
slides.sourceLine: August terms; accounts pp37–38,65; October slide33; group deed 28 Aug. SONIA: Sterling Overnight Index Average. pp: percentage points.
slides.mechanism: Equity and debt allocate project risk differently, while a rising margin increases the cost of a slower ramp.
slides.caveat: Do not infer executed loan terms, first-ranking security or exact maturity from the deed.

slides.title: The August plan combined £61m financing with other cash sources
slides.scope: Original plan dated 25 August 2026   /   GBP million   /   Unspecified peak funding date
slides.sourceLine: RNS9611R Appendix Sources and Uses. Model August plan. Later repayment reported 28 Aug.
slides.mechanism: The plan reserves depend on anticipated collections as well as financing, and uses include replacement of prior bridge debt.
slides.caveat: Forecast receipts, recoveries and planned uses are not verified bank flows.

slides.title: October guidance leaves £40–45m of project expenditure
slides.scope: Management estimate released 13 October 2026   /   GBP million   /   Operating costs excluded
slides.sourceLine: October presentation slide20. Model Funding!D16:D17,D27:D28. Financial years end 31 March.
slides.mechanism: The spending range measures remaining project work. Payment timing and operating flows govern its liquidity effect.
slides.caveat: Do not subtract this range from gross financing to manufacture cash.

slides.title: The illustrative downside adds £5.75m above the spending reference
slides.scope: October-based analyst stress   /   GBP million incremental   /   No accordion draw assumed
slides.sourceLine: Accounts p38: three-month fallback-processing sensitivity. October slide20. Model Funding!D18:D23, Downside.
slides.mechanism: Capex range, fallback-processing delay and simple rate exposure describe distinct sources of incremental cash uses.
slides.caveat: Illustrative increment, not guidance, current cash requirement or forecast costs.

slides.title: Deferring August receipts removes the plan’s cash reserve
slides.scope: Historical August counterfactual   /   GBP million   /   All other original-plan items held fixed
slides.sourceLine: RNS9611R funding appendix, 25 Aug. Model August plan!D35:D37 with receipts factor 0.
slides.mechanism: Collections timing supported the planned reserve. Deferral changes historical-plan ending cash without establishing actual non-receipt.
slides.caveat: Neither rounding convention is an observed current deficit.

slides.title: Commissioning must establish repeatable payable output
slides.scope: Reported milestones and management guidance   /   No independently verified steady-state performance
slides.sourceLine: Processing release, 15 Sep. October presentation, operating milestones and FY2028 guidance.
slides.mechanism: Operational performance controls payable volume and cost per unit, so commissioning progress needs a cash-conversion test.
slides.caveat: Targets and reported milestones remain distinct from verified sustained production.

slides.title: Elmet provides a contracted outlet with variable-price receipts
slides.scope: Agreement announced 23 September 2026   /   1,000t contained WO3 annually for eight years
slides.sourceLine: Issuer RNS8695V in FCA NSM, highlights and further information. APT: ammonium paratungstate. Delivery/payment dates unresolved.
slides.mechanism: The sequence exposes the contractual and working-capital steps between plant output and cash available to creditors.
slides.caveat: The nominal contract value is not guaranteed revenue. The additional 500t provision remains conditional.

slides.title: The short loan horizon makes the cash-conversion timetable material
slides.scope: Announced 366-day tenor   /   FY2028 financing-service guidance   /   Exact maturity unresolved
slides.sourceLine: August terms: agreement-date origin. Accounts p38: drawdown origin. October slides23,33. Deed 28 Aug.
slides.mechanism: A relatively short core loan places repayment or replacement capital close to the ramp, while equipment service extends beyond it.
slides.caveat: Tenors and fiscal-year service are separate disclosed measures. Exact core-loan maturity remains unresolved.

slides.title: Each capital provider needs a different test of the operating ramp
slides.scope: Institutional decision matrix   /   Independent SMPT interpretation
slides.sourceLine: Accepted memo sections3,6,7 and Phase1B information-request checklist. No investment recommendation or lender underwriting.
slides.mechanism: The same operating facts inform residual returns, debt recovery and strategic supply through different contractual exposures.
slides.caveat: No human professional endorsement is implied.

slides.title: Collections and financing terms will shape the next assessment
slides.scope: Financial conclusion   /   Supported restart pathway with specific monitoring priorities
slides.sourceLine: Accepted FI001 memo and Phase1B closure. Review candidate retains the 4 November 2026 research cutoff.
slides.mechanism: Financing has strengthened access to capital. Cash conversion and a documented financing calendar determine how confidently that progress can be underwritten.
slides.caveat: Current cash, a complete funding gap, valuation and repayment sufficiency remain outside this evidence base.

slides.title: Source dates and financial observation dates serve different purposes
slides.scope: Appendix A   /   Primary-source hierarchy and date reconciliation
slides.sourceLine: All sources resolve to the accepted Phase1A register. No live evidence refresh. Full locators also in source-appendix.md.
slides.mechanism: Preserving observation and publication dates prevents later disclosures from becoming falsely contemporaneous cash balances.
slides.caveat: Issuer reports remain attributed and are not independent production verification.

slides.title: Instrument status limits which amounts can be aggregated
slides.scope: Appendix B   /   Capital and liability classification register
slides.sourceLine: Accounts and August terms; bridge releases 21 May / 28 Aug; April release 8 Apr; October slide33.
slides.mechanism: Financing classification prevents facility limits, conditional capacity, historical stocks and overlapping equipment amounts from becoming a spurious debt or cash total.
slides.caveat: Equipment service and principal require instrument-level reconciliation.

slides.title: The four findings reconcile to the accepted financial model
slides.scope: Appendix C   /   Model hash and calculation checks   /   GBP million unless stated
slides.sourceLine: Accepted workbook SHA-256 da37ccd1…4562895f7. Full hash and cell provenance in validation-results.json.
slides.mechanism: Explicit arithmetic and workbook provenance preserve the financial meanings of all four headline results.
slides.caveat: The grouped model selector does not assign joint probability or make the separate scenarios additive.

slides.title: Liquidity and executed terms are the highest-value next disclosures
slides.scope: Appendix D   /   Ranked diligence requests from the accepted Phase1B record
slides.sourceLine: Phase1B information-request checklist. No outreach undertaken. A new evidence update needs separate authorization.
slides.mechanism: The requests progress from closing the cash stock to timing obligations and demonstrating commercial conversion.
slides.caveat: Current funding gap, DSCR, valuation and repayment assurance remain unavailable.
